sentence: This project studies how lipid droplets in the brain change during normal aging and Alzheimer's disease.
This project stores genetics data and resources that the research community uses to study Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to turn stem cells into parathyroid-like cells that could help patients who cannot keep healthy levels of calcium.
This project builds a way to see brain connections in post-mortem specimens using light microscopy.
This project builds a method to study the proteins made by bacteria in cancer samples collected in the clinic.
This project develops a rapid imaging technique to detect early changes in lung tissue caused by chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
This project studies how a matrix protein of filoviruses changes shape and helps the virus assemble.
This project uses crowdsourcing and machine learning to predict autism spectrum disorder and attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder in adolescents.
This project builds a nanopore assay to detect RNA and protein biomarkers and studies how they drive synovial sarcoma progression.
This project studies how social stressors affect the immune system and blood stem cells in acute myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how age changes the cells of the human lung and blood using single-cell data and machine learning.
This project uses gene editing tools on human blood stem cells to make them resistant to HIV.
This project gives researchers access to methods that measure metabolism, such as metabolomics, stable isotope tracers and imaging, in nutrition and obesity studies.
This project studies the costs and benefits of population-based genetic testing for hereditary cancer syndromes.
This project tries to find and make bioactive natural products from less-studied microbes.
This project develops imaging methods to explore the human brain using functional and diffusion magnetic resonance imaging.
This project studies how sphingolipid ceramides contribute to coronary artery disease using animal models.
This project builds microfluidic tools to study signaling between human immune cells and fibroblasts and between microbes.
This project measures how the shape and movement of the subtalar joint change in patients after ankle fusion surgery for ankle osteoarthritis.
This project builds a computational toolkit to find genomic variation in human leukocyte antigen genes and link it to disease.
